<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <final id="a">
    <onentry>
      <script><![CDATA[
        var q = 1;
        if (q < 2) { q = q +* 3; }
      ]]></script>
    </onentry>
  </final>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: ecmascript syntax error in `<script>`: unexpected `*` where an operand was expected
notes: a script that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` and aborts the rest of its executable-content block
diagnostics.help: fix the ecmascript syntax at the marked position: `*` cannot appear there
